notes: Nordyne-family system, encoded independently from this page's own text (no usesStylesOf: shared-system use by the page's listed sister/similar brands is not established by this page alone). Page positions are stated as 'numerical digits' but the page examples only decode under the character-position reading (e.g. style 1 GBB030708229: characters 4-5 = '03', 6-7 = '07'); that reading is used throughout and every example decodes under it. Page styles 3, 4 and 5 (the second style numbered 4 on the page) are merged into one shipped style: after normalization (spaces/dashes stripped) all three have the identical shape letter-digit-letter + 9 digits and the identical year/month positions, so they are one system, not three colliding styles; all three page examples are carried as examples of the merged style. Page images are diagrams, not letter tables; no chart values were needed.

styles.notes: Page positions 4-5 = year, 6-7 = month (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open [3,5] and [5,7].
Page example shown as 'F3891 4228'; space stripped by normalization. Page positions 3-4 (1-based) = year, converted to [2,4]. No month is stated for this style, so it ships year-only.

styles.era: 12-character serials, letter-digit-letter + 9 digits (page styles 3, 4 and 5 merged)
styles.notes: Page style 3 example 'G6R9905-05028', page style 4 example 'M 1 G 9807 - 05432', page style 5 (misnumbered as a second style 4 on the page) example 'E2E-9705 01234'; all normalize to letter-digit-letter + 9 digits with year at normalized positions [3,5] and month at [5,7]. Page-stated positions differ by raw counting (dashes/spaces included) but coincide after normalization, which is why the three page styles collapse to this single style.
